input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen (flagship 6) shift-roster-builder: --cover-price moves two shifts together (relief, trade, relay of a stand-in's shifts)
errors: First pair-move design (relay/relief only where the stand-in could take j outright) generated zero candidates: coverRisk's chains already credit exactly those, so a risky day never has one. Diagnosed and broadened to any shift of the stand-in plus two-person trades.

Unscreened pair moves took 38 s on the 60-person week; a per-case screen then lost every gain (the freed stand-in covers other days). Shipped a screen over all risky days the movers could stand in on, and a 200-copy default cap.
First accepted version took a relief that kept risk equal and only saved score; measured exposure on that roster rose 54 -> 66 h. Added the rule that a two-shift move must cut risk hours.

doc_friction.issue: A Bash heredoc that wrote a JS file containing template literals was refused by the rm-safety check ('could not be checked for dangerous rm operations') though it had no rm; writing the file with the Write tool worked. Worth a line in cloud-session.md.

notes: Verification: eval/cover-pairs.mjs (templates + seeded 20/40/60-person weeks, pairs off vs on, $25 and $100), eval/cover-pairs-exposure.mjs (calloutExposure: 20x56 week 2 113 -> 68 h for $35.27). cover-price.test.mjs 18/18 locally; run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder result in the PR body. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README section carries what the next run needs, and flagships.yaml next: is updated.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design, implement and measure a local-search move class with two eval harnesses and tests for a scheduling optimizer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
